_about: The official benchmark environment (bench/README.md, 'Official environment'): the Linux VM of the Claude desktop app on the user's Mac, where the Powerpoint folder lives. bench_run.py compares libreoffice, poppler, arch and pptxgenjs with this and marks other runs as not comparable. Change it only on purpose, with a changelog row, and re-run all cases when you do.
where: Mac, Claude desktop app VM (device_bash), folder ~/mnt/Powerpoint
fonts: Arial -> Liberation Sans; Microsoft YaHei -> Noto Sans CJK SC
